name: Jezero Crater
coordinate_note: Per-site numbers were collected by Hermes with source URLs and not independently re-checked by Claude. status=sourced means a URL exists; unverified means no published number was found (leave empty, do not estimate); weak_source means the only source is Wikipedia and should be replaced. Site coordinates are approximate and from memory: verify against the USGS Mars gazetteer before use.

facts.unit: m (below the Mars areoid per the FU Berlin HRSC page; MOLA DEM agrees)

verified.detail: Page says floor is 2,700 m below Mars 'sea level' (areoid) on the HRSC map; it does not name MOLA. Number is right, datum label corrected. Our MOLA DEM agrees (min -2,716 m within 25 km).
Carnegie: 180 (sand dune) to 605 (bedrock-dominated) SI units. THEMIS sample here reads 353 (313-391).
Sci. Adv. title: compositionally and density stratified igneous terrain; volcanic and intrusive.
Science paper: 'Carbonated ultramafic igneous rocks in Jezero crater'; igneous, altered by CO2-bearing water.

facts.value: Cheyava Falls / Sapphire Canyon: organics plus vivianite and greigite

verified.detail: JPL: Sapphire Canyon (Cheyava Falls) potential biosignatures; vivianite and greigite plus organic carbon.

facts.note: no skylight or lava-tube data for this site
